Parallel Park Challenge

The hardest move in driving — four steps, one tight spot. Watch the sensor as you go.

Parking sensor
Step 1 of 4
In Context
The Tightest Spot in Town
There's only one spot left on the street, right between two parked cars. You pull alongside (para ao lado) the car in front of the spot and check your mirrors.

Slowly, you reverse (dá ré), turning the wheel toward the curb. Halfway in, you turn the wheel (vira o volante) the other way, letting the back of the car swing into the gap.

One last check, and you straighten out (endireita) — perfectly parked, with room to spare on both sides.
